items.question: What abstention from vegetables is required for seven nights after the ritual act?
premises: The practitioner must not touch vegetables.
This abstention lasts for seven nights.
The instruction is addressed to Kāmeśvarī, the beloved left-hearted one.
items.inference: After the specified ritual act, one must avoid vegetables for seven nights.
uncertainties: The exact referent of the prior ritual act depends on the preceding verse.
items.plain_english: O beloved Kāmeśvarī, dwelling in the left heart, one should not touch vegetables for seven nights.
